errors.text: The proposed SPS heating rate of approximately 100°C/min conflicts with the target condition of 50°C/min, while the required 10-minute vacuum dwell, 400 rpm milling speed, and 20:1 ball-to-powder ratio are omitted.

The claimed 1050°C decomposition threshold is not established by the cited evidence; PMC7866258 concerns a different CrMoNbWV alloy processed at 1200–1400°C and cannot validate this CoCrFeNiTi-specific boundary.

The hardness load of 0.1 kgf does not reconstruct the target 0.05 kN load and load variation alone cannot isolate Hall–Petch strengthening from precipitation hardening without phase- or grain-size-matched controls.
